page_title: WOL 5-1 MON | Wolfsburg v B. Monchengladbach 14/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+2' That's the end of the match.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
89' 5 - 1 Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
87' 5 - 0 Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and sends a low drive past the goalkeeper.
84' 4 - 0 Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) hits a shot towards goal after getting on the end of a cross and the goalkeeper fails to keep it out even though the ball is not struck perfectly!
81' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Tomas Cvancara and he is replaced by Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach).
81' Today's match ends for Joe Scally who will be replaced by Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
81' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Rocco Reitz will be replaced by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach).
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is replacing Konstantinos Koulierakis.
78' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Florian Badstubner saw the whole situation. B. Monchengladbach will take a free kick.
75' 3 - 0 Goal! Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
73' The substitution has been made. Lukas Nmecha (Wolfsburg) has replaced Jonas Wind.
73' It is time for a substitution. Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is on for Bence Dardai.
70' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Luca Netz is replaced by Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach).
70' That will be all from Robin Hack who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach).
68' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) fails to produce a decent enough free kick for a player of his ability and the only target that he finds is the wall of defenders in front of him.
63' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) commits a rough foul. Florian Badstubner stops the game and makes a call. A free kick to Wolfsburg.

60' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Jonas Wind, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg), who beats Moritz Nicolas with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
58' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner with a short pass.
55' Konstantinos Koulierakis (Wolfsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach get a free kick.
52' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
51' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
51' Kilian Fischer (Wolfsburg) commits a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
49' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
48' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) makes a strong challenge and Florian Badstubner blows for a foul. Wolfsburg will take a free kick near the side line.
46' The whistle blows and Florian Badstubner starts the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+1' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) is being substituted because of an injury. Ralph Hasenhuttl sends Patrick Wimmer on the pitch.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
43' The corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by the defence.
41' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) sees a yellow card from Florian Badstubner after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
39' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
35' Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the right post.

34' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball after the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom left corner, but Kamil Grabara makes a nice save.
32' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
32' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
31' Bence Dardai (Wolfsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Wolfsburg.

28' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Florian Badstubner blows for a foul. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
27' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
25' The resulting corner from Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) is cleared.

25' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) controls the ball from the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper has a clear sight of the shot and thwarts him with a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for B. Monchengladbach.
25' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

24' Two players stand over the free kick. Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) eventually steps forward, but his attempt from the edge of the box is blocked by the defensive wall. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to B. Monchengladbach.
24' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
23' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) takes a short corner kick.

22' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
20' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the right side of the goal, but Kamil Grabara has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
17' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from B. Monchengladbach comes to nothing.
14' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. B. Monchengladbach force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
12' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot goalwards, but the keeper produces a decent save!
9' The game is interrupted as Mohamed Amoura (Wolfsburg) is flagged offside.
3' 1 - 0 GOAL! Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) takes a real chance, but his low driven penalty into the middle of the net fools Moritz Nicolas in goal.
3' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
2' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) makes a rough challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Wolfsburg!
1' The first half has just begun.
Wolfsburg will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
